description: Dev 900 traces of the prompted loop (follow tools, 5895 verifier) under two controllers: qwen3.8-flash, and the 2B imitation controller trained on flash's train trajectories. Baselines for controller GRPO, and two controller GRPO runs from the imitation controller (300 and 1,000 train claims).

local-imitation-run1-follow.jsonl.gz.command: python -m agent.prompted --tools follow --controller local:<run1 checkpoints> --claim-ids verifier/data/eval/fever-dev-900-ids.json --chunk 64 --adapter verifier/experiments/sft-direct-from-base-qwen3p5-2b-5895-samples/runs/run1/artifacts/checkpoints

local-grpo-ctl-300-run1-follow.jsonl.gz.command: sbatch --export=ALL,CONTROLLER=local:<imitation run1 checkpoints>,GRPO=<300-claim GRPO run1 checkpoints> verifier/evaluation/eval_controller.sbatch (python -m agent.prompted --tools follow --chunk 64 --controller local:<imitation>,<grpo> --adapter <5895 run1> --claim-ids verifier/data/eval/fever-dev-900-ids.json)

local-grpo-ctl-1000-run1-follow.jsonl.gz.command: sbatch --export=ALL,CONTROLLER=local:<imitation run1 checkpoints>,GRPO=<1000-claim GRPO run1 checkpoints> verifier/evaluation/eval_controller.sbatch (python -m agent.prompted --tools follow --chunk 64 --controller local:<imitation>,<grpo> --adapter <5895 run1> --claim-ids verifier/data/eval/fever-dev-900-ids.json)
